Pilot · Canada

Robert Piché

Air Transat Flight 2362001
Flight
Air Transat Flight 236
Date
24 August 2001
Aircraft
Airbus A330
Location
Lajes, Azores
Survivors
306 of 306 aboard

A fuel leak caused both engines of the Airbus A330 to fail over the Atlantic. He glided the aircraft to a landing at Lajes in the Azores, and all 306 people aboard survived.

Who helped

  • Dirk DeJager First officerDeclared the Mayday and, according to investigators, gave the captain full and effective support through the engines-out glide and landing.Sources: 1 2 3
